description: Multipart/form-data parsing tests (RFC 7578). Given a multipart request body, parse into individual parts with name, filename, contentType, and body.

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.1: Content-Type with boundary parameter is preserved
tests.rawBody:
--AaB03x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field1"

value1
--AaB03x--

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.1: Content-Type with quoted boundary extracts correctly
tests.rawBody:
------WebKitFormBoundary7MA4YWxk
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="field1"

value1
------WebKitFormBoundary7MA4YWxk--

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.2: single text field parsed correctly
tests.rawBody:
--AaB03x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="title"

My Blog Post
--AaB03x--

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.2: field with empty value
tests.rawBody:
--AaB03x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="excerpt"


--AaB03x--

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.2: multiple text fields in order
tests.rawBody:
--AaB03x Content-Disposition: form-data; name="title" My Post --AaB03x Content-Disposition: form-data; name="status" publish --AaB03x Content-Disposition: form-data; name="content"

Hello world

--AaB03x--

tests.description: RFC 7578 §4.2: file upload with filename and content-type
tests.rawBody:
--AaB03x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="test.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain

Hello, this is a test file.
--AaB03x--

parts.name: file
parts.body: Hello, this is a test file.
